source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    objects = []
    for color in {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
        r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
        c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        crop = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
        objects.append((c0, crop))
    objects.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
    out_h = max(len(obj) for _, obj in objects)
    out = [[] for _ in range(out_h)]
    for _, obj in objects:
        oh, ow = len(obj), len(obj[0])
        top = (out_h - oh) // 2
        for r in range(out_h):
            out[r].extend(obj[r - top] if top <= r < top + oh else [0] * ow)
    return out
'''
